_comment: No exe: resolves to this account's own %LOCALAPPDATA%\FunFly\Last War-Survival Game\LastWarLauncher.exe. No password: read from Windows Credential Manager, so this file holds no secret — store it once with `--user user2 --save-credential`.
An explicit exe wins over the per-profile install. `domain` may be added for a non-local account; `cwd` overrides the working directory.
